user.title: Connect to Air-Mixer
user.description: Enter the address of the Air-Mixer server. Home Assistant and Air-Mixer must be able to reach each other: Air-Mixer downloads the audio Home Assistant sends it.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the Air-Mixer server.
data_description.port: The web UI and API port, 9001 by default.

error.unhealthy: Air-Mixer answered but reports a problem. Check its logs.

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Plays a clip, speech or an alarm on Air-Mixer outputs, lowering or silencing other audio while it plays and restoring it afterwards.

entity_id.name: Outputs
entity_id.description: Air-Mixer outputs to play on. Leave empty for every output.

media_content_id.name: Media
media_content_id.description: A URL of an MP3 or WAV file, or a media source item such as a local file or text-to-speech.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: What happens to other audio while this plays.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Volume of the announcement, from 0 to 1.

duck_level.name: Duck level
duck_level.description: Volume of other audio while ducked, from 0 to 1. The default is 0.2.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: How many times to play it.

loop.name: Loop
loop.description: Repeat until stopped, for alarms. Stop it with the Air-Mixer stop action or by stopping the media player.

title.name: Title
title.description: Shown as the media title while it plays.

wait.name: Wait
wait.description: Wait until playback ends before the action completes, so a script can run steps in order.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Stops what Home Assistant sent to Air-Mixer outputs. Other audio is not affected.

entity_id.name: Outputs
entity_id.description: Air-Mixer outputs to stop. Leave empty for every output.
